answer_2.quote: To demonstrate the impact of the speaker diarization system, we report the Diarization Error Rate (DER) , which generally composed of three parts: Missed Speech (MS), False Alarms (FA) and Speaker Error (SPKE). As the ASR and forced-alignment module have been used in the pipeline, we also report the Concatenated Minimum-permutation Word Error Rate .
